results.title: Prerender.io pricing changes: what changed and what it means for your plan
results.snippet: Prerender.io launched four new plans (Starter, Growth, Pro, and Enterprise Plus) in October 2025, replacing all previous plans and add-ons. All existing customers were migrated to the closest matching new plan on November 17, 2025.
